scope.windowRule: N must be 40960..0x180000, wire protocol v2; S[i]=floor(floor(N*i/10)/4096)*4096 for i=0..9; Ri=[S[i], S[i+1]-1], last=[S[9], N-1]. No hand-tuned windows after any observation.

scope.recovery: Uncertain dispatch/release/device state: reconcile originals first. pipeline-recover is only for existing bound remote restoration, never another dispatch/OTA; require its own documented admission if needed. No lock deletion, force-stop during unknown apply, reset, flash or downgrade.
scope.whole_card: FROZEN/NOT_RUN before execution. No prior pipeline failure relabeled; development partial observations and successful local configuration checks are not final acceptance.
